scope: Fresh native timings, optional scalar Kalman residual: prequential C replay, no scheduler or model speed change

method.calibration: Same E19 sparse/diverse interleaved grid, 63 labels per coverage/cap; all anchors excluded
method.noise: Diverse training group sample variance only; R=max(.25,median variance), NNLS scaled R=max(.25,c0+c1*(base/100)^2), Q=.01*R, P0=alpha*R
method.initialization: Bias0; no evaluation filter warmup; alpha=(sqrt(.01^2+4*.01)-.01)/2
method.order: Within each native base and cap: predict every layer, then observe unfiltered-base residual; no future/current label leakage
method.layer: Numeric C offline replay of fresh measured labels; 882 predictions reference 294 original native jobs, not extra inference jobs
method.time: Warm native wall time; microtable/load/warmup/oracle excluded; filter CPU overhead measured separately
method.diagnostics: Innovation / sqrt(Pprior+R); nominal +-1.96 coverage descriptive, not guaranteed Gaussian or confidence interval

limits: Single M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B run; no Windows/CUDA or scheduler verification
Constant Q/R steady-state Kalman equals EWMA; not an independent accuracy gain
Changing task-dependent bias can contaminate following tasks; Gaussian and independent noise unproven
Q advances per successful observation, not wall-clock time; scaled variance can be misspecified
No evaluation tuning or best-run selection; no claim of faster model kernels

unit.cases: analytic Joseph/gain, read-only, EWMA equivalence, step, spike propagation, zero-Q, clamp, profile/range and atomicity
